b: Pao bataru aregodure Jonas, Amitai onaregedu, bogai, tagoi oino dutabo aragojedo, atudo Nínive ba kurirewu kurirewu kae, amagodo ji ro pegarewu aregoduie itae duji.
source: Pao bataru aregodure Jonas, Amati onaregedu, bogai, tagoi oino dutabo aragojedo, atudo Nínive bakurirewu kurirewu kae, amagodo ji ro pegarewu aregoduie itae duji.
p:
Veio a palavra do Senhor a Jonas, filho de Amitai, dizendo:
Levanta-te, vai à cidade de Nínive, e clama contra ela, porque a sua malícia subiu até à minha presença.

b: Jonas uture turegodu tabo Tarsis ba kurirewu kae, Pao piji. Ure turawuje Jope ba kurirewu kae, kejere jordure ia ika kurirewu ui tuduiagu Tarsis kae duji, ure tudumode torodu morido, icare ure taredo ika kurirewu to, tugoduwo nowu boe ebo Tarsis kae, Pao piji.
source: Jonas uture turegodu tabo Tarsis bakurirewu kae, Pao piji. Ure turawuje Jope bakurirewu kae, kejere jordure ia ika kurirewu ui tuduiagu Tarsis kae duji, ure tudumode torodu morido, icare ure taredo ika kurireuto, tugoduwo nowu boe ebo Tarsis kae, Pao piji.
p: Porém, Jonas se levantou para fugir da presença do Senhor para Társis. E descendo a Jope, achou um navio que ia para Társis; pagou, pois, a sua passagem, e desceu para dentro dele, para ir com eles para Társis, para longe da presença do Senhor.

b: Mare Paore ia bakuru rakarewu butudo pobo maerewu keje; bakuru rakaguragarewu kodire nowu ika kurirewu tuwogwaiagu pobo to.
source: Mare Paore ia bakuru rakarewu butudo pobo maerewu keje; bakuru rakaguragarewu kodire nowu ika kurirewu tuwogwaiagu poboto.
p: Mas o Senhor mandou ao mar um grande vento, e fez-se no mar uma forte tempestade, e o navio estava a ponto de quebrar-se.

b: Ika kurirewu epage epagudugodu kuricigore, eiamedu boe enogwamagudure tu tu to aroe eimejera bogai, icare, ika kurirewu barigoduwo puduidu bogaire, ere ia oroe barigu pobo to. Du tona ji Jonasre turawuje ika kurirewu upo kae, ure tuwu dukeje icare unudure rabodu.
source: Ika kurirewu epage epagudugodu kuricigore, eiamedu boe enogwamagudure tu tu to aroe eimejera bogai, icare, ika kurirewu barigoduwo puduidu bogaire, ere ia oroe barigu poboto. Du tonaji Jonasre turawuje ika kurirewu upo kae, ure tuwu dukeje icare unudure rabodu.
p: Então temeram os marinheiros, e clamavam cada um ao seu deus, e lançaram ao mar as cargas, que estavam no navio, para o aliviarem do seu peso; Jonas, porém, desceu ao porão do navio, e, tendo-se deitado, dormia um profundo sono.

b: Icare nowu jeture nowu ika kurirewu oroe jiwu ure tuburedo ji, akore kodi icare anudure? Aragojedo, akogwamagududo ako Aroe Eimejera bogai. Ia dukeje aidumode tumearudae butudo pawugeje tuwo paginorudo pawi piji.
source: Icare nowu jeture nowu ika kurirewu oroe jiwu ure tuburedo ji, akore kodi icare anudure? Aragojedo, akogwamagududo ako Aroe Eimejera bogai. Ia dukeje aidumode tumearudae butudo pawugeje tuwo paginorudo pawi piji.
p: E o capitão do navio chegou-se a ele, e disse-lhe: Que tens, dorminhoco? Levanta-te, clama ao teu Deus; talvez assim esse Deus se lembre de nós para que não pereçamos.

b: Icare metage egore oino pui pawo pageragudu caido barigu, paeruduwo ioguduba koiare ure boedo oino pai. Ere boere tugeragu caidu barigu, du buture Jonas keje.
source: Icare metage egore oino pui pawo pageragudu caido barigu, paerduwo ioguduba koiare ure boedo oino pai. Ere boere tugeragu caidu barigu, du buture Jonas keje.
p: E diziam cada um ao seu companheiro: Vinde, e lancemos sortes, para que saibamos por que causa nos sobreveio este mal. E lançaram sortes, e a sorte caiu sobre Jonas.

b: Du kodi icare egore oino ji cewie inoba ure kodiba boere oino pai? Kakoduboeba amaragodae rema Kaiba pijiba akaregodure? Kakoduwuba ako moto rema? Kakoduwu boe eiba aenare?
source: Du kodi icare egore oino ji cewie inoba ure kodiba boere oino pai? Kakoduboeba amaragodae rema Kaiba pijiba akaregodure? Kakoduwuba ako moto rema? Kakoduwu boe eiba aenare?
p: Então lhe disseram: Declara-nos tu agora, por causa de quem nos sobreveio este mal. Que ocupação é a tua? Donde vens? Qual é a tua terra? E de que povo és tu?

b: Akore oino ei hebreinure imi. Imearutorure Aroe Eimejera baru tadawu ji, duwu ure pobo maerewu, moto, towuje.
source: Akore oino ei hebrei nure imi. Imearutorure Aroe Eimejera baru tadawuji, duwu ure pobo maerewu, moto, towuje.
p: E ele lhes disse: Eu sou hebreu, e temo ao Senhor, o Deus do céu, que fez o mar e a terra seca.

b: Nowu ime epagudugodu kuricigore, ere boe pa rekodu raaboduie Pao piji duji; enoragodure ji inoba arore?
source: Nowu ime epagudugodu kuricigore, ere boe pa rekodu raaboduie Pao piji duji; enoragodure ji inoba arore?

b: Egore oino ji kimo inoba ceromode ai, pobo maerewu butugugoduwo cei du bogai? Paga karega, ui taogadodu kodure tao kae.
source: Egore oino ji kimo inoba ceromode ai, pobo maerewu butugugoduwo cei du bogai? Paga karega, ui taogadodu kodure tao kae.

b: Jonas Akore oino ei tageragu ii, iwarigu pobo maereuto, nono, pobo maerewu butugugodumode tai; paga karega, iorduware igoiaie boere oino tai duji.
source: Jonas Akore oino ei tageragu ii, iwarigu pobo maereuto, nono, pobo maerewu butugugodumode tai; paga karega, iorduware igoiaie boere oino tai duji.

b: Icare nowu imere tudaraiga jodo pobo keje tuduru jamedu boe tabo taregoduwo pobo okwa pa kae, mare eroiwakare, pobuto boe ekodure tao kae kodi.
source: Icare nowu imere tudaraiga jodo pobo keje tuduru jamedu boe tabo taregoduwo pobo okwa pa kae, mare eroiwakare, pobuto boe ekodure tao kae kodi.

b: Du kodi icare enogwamagudure Aroe Eimejera bogai, egore Pagimejera, cewogwa kawo awu imedu jiboe koia, akaba ro pegakarewu boe ku ku butudo cewugeje, akire arore nono akaidu reore kodi.
source: Du kodi icare enogwamagudure Aroe Eimejera bogai, egore Pagimejera, cewogwa kawo awu imedu jiboe koia, akaba ro pegakarewu boe ku ku butudo cewugeje, akire arore nono akaidu reore kodi.

b: Tagoi oino dutabo icare ere tugeragu Jonas ji, ere barigu pobo maereuto, icare boe butugugodure.
source: Tagoi oino dutabo icare ere tugeragu Jonas ji, ere barigu pobo maereuto, icare boe butugugodure.

b: Du kodi icare nowu ime emearutoru kuricigore Pao ji, ere tomea maku ai, ere turomededu boe to ai.
source: Du kodi icare nowu ime emearutoru kuricigore Pao ji, ere tomea maku ai, ere turomededu boe to ai.

b: Paore ia karo kuricigorewu udo Jonas kowuje, meture nowu karo kuri tada merire pobe ma jewu metuia bokware.
source: Paore ia karo kuricigorewu udo Jonas kowuje, meture nowu karo kuri tada merire pobe ma jewu metuia bokware.

b: Du keje icare Paore nowu karo owearigo Jonas apo kugaru keje.
source: Du keje icare Paore nowu karo owearigo Jonas apo kugaru keje.

b: Pao bataru aregodure Jonas bogai pugeje, tagoi oino dutabo aragojedo, atudo bakurirewu kurirewu iere Nínive cedu kae, ewie imagomode aiwu bakaruji.
source: Pao bataru aregodure Jonas bogai pugeje, tagoi oino dutabo aragojedo, atudo bakurirewu kurirewu iere Nínive cedu kae, ewie imagomode aiwu bakaruji.

b: Icare Jonas ure turagojedo, uture Nínive kae, Pao bakaru rekodaji. Bakurirewu kuricigorewu nure Ninivece; merimode pobe kma jewu metuia bokware boe epaduwo kajeje.
source: Icare Jonas ure turagojedo, uture Nínive kae, Pao bakaru rekodaji. Bakurirewu kuricigorewu nure Ninivece; merimode pobe kma jewu metuia bokware boe epaduwo kajeje.

b: Jonas merure nowu bakurirewu kao meri jameduji jii meri butu kae. Oiogwarire oino merimode pagera awubodure pobe puibiji dukeje, Nínive pegadodumode.
source: Jonas merure nowu bakurirewu kao meri jameduji jii meri butu kae. Oiogwarire oino merimode pagera awubodure pobe puibiji dukeje, Nínive pegadodumode.

b: Nínive kejewu boe emearutorure Pao ji. Eimejerage egore boe eiamedu boe etodorogaiagu pudui, du kodi icare biegareuge, kurireuge eiamedu ere aroia iku kurirewu opodo pudabo.
source: Nínive kejewu boe emearutorure Pao ji. Eimejerage egore boe eiamedu boe etodorogaiagu pudui, du kodi icare biegareuge, kurireuge eiamedu ere aroia iku kurirewu opodo pudabo.

b: Awu bakaru aregodure Nínive kejewu brae eimejera kurirewu biaja kae. Icare ure turagojedo tumuga piji, ure opore pudabowu aroia boarewu tawuje tubiji, ure aroia iku kurirewu tugu pudui, ure tumugudu jorugudu tada. Nowu brae eimejera, nowu utugarege kurireuge, egore nowu uwadodureuge ewadoduwo boe etae, egowo oino boe ji boe, barege, tapiradoge, barege kugure, emodukare boe ko, ekudumodukare poboce. Boe, barege, emode aroia iku kurirewu opodo pudabo. Emagomode Aroe Eimejera ji tuduru tabo, emode tukirimi tudawara pegarewu piji, emode turo pegare tugera tabodu pijido jamedu. Boe jokodukare kare, Pao umodukana tudaru, umode tugirimi tuibagi, umode tugera ra boe korii pui dupiji, ma, pawogwa kawo.
source: Awu bakaru aregodure Nínive kejewu brae eimejera kurirewu biaja kae. Icare ure turagojedo tumuga piji, ure opore pudabowu aroia boarewu tawuje tubiji, ure aroia iku kurirewu tugu pudui, ure tumugudu jorugudu tada. Nowu brae eimejera, nowu utugarege kurireuge, egore nowu uwadodureuge ewadoduwo boe etae, egowo oino boe ji boe, barege, tapiradoge, barege kugure, emodukare boe ko, ekudumodukare poboce. Boe, barege, emode aroia iku kurirewu opodo pudabo. Emagomode Aroe Eimejera ji tuduru tabo, emode tukirimi tudawara pegarewu piji, emode turo pegare tugera tabodu pijido jamedu. Boe jokodukare kare, Pao umodukana tudaru, umode tugirimi tuibagi, umode tugera ra boe korii pui dupiji, ma, pawogwa kawo.

b: Pao Aroe Eimejera jordure eroi oino duji, ei tudaru tudawara pegarewu piji duji, icare okudure ebo, uro turo pegamode eidu bokwado.
source: Pao Aroe Eimejera jordure eroi oino duji, ei tudaru tudawara pegarewu piji duji, icare okudure ebo, uro turo pegamode eidu bokwado.

b: Pao butugugodui Nínive bakurirewu jitu keje, Jonas kiarigodu kuricigore, korigodure pudui.
source: Pao butugugodui Nínive bakurirewu jitu keje, Jonas kiarigodu kuricigore, korigodure pudui.

b: Du kodi icare akore oino Pao ji Ikimejera, nowu inoduji karega inagoino iragoje kimoi ino moto keje dutabo? Du kodire icare ire akedo ii iregoduwo Tarsis kae; mare paga karega, iorduwa pemegare Aroe Eimejera pemegarewu okudurewu iure aki; awudugugodure ai akorigoduji, are amode eiwo pegadodu akedudo taci apiji. Kodi icare inogwamagudumode oino ai, awo iragoja kedodo; ure turugadu iwiwo, iragoje kawo.
source: Du kodi icare akore oino Pao ji Ikimejera, nowu inoduji karega inagoino iragoje kimoi ino moto keje dutabo? Du kodire icare ire akedo ii iregoduwo Tarsis kae; mare paga karega, iorduwa pemegare Aroe Eimejera pemegarewu okudurewu iure aki; awudugugodure ai akorigoduji, are amode eiwo pegadodu akedudo taci apiji. Kodi icare inogwamagudumode oino ai, awo iragoja kedodo; ure turugadu iwiwo, iragoje kawo.

b: Mare Pao akore oino ji boe rugadu akorigodure oino nowu inodu koia?
source: Mare Pao akore oino ji boe rugadu akorigodure oino nowu inodu koia?

b: Jonas ure tudawuje nowu bakurirewu piji, icare ure tumugudo meri rutu jaogwai, nono icare ure ia bai mugudo pudai, nonore icare ure tumugudo tuwo tamudo ia boetugu kuda, tubaga taba inoba boemode bakurirewu jitu bogai.
source: Jonas ure tudawuje nowu bakurirewu piji, icare ure tumugudo meri rutu jaogwai, nono icare ure ia bai mugudo pudai, nonore icare ure tumugudo tuwo tamudo ia boetugu kuda, tubaga taba inoba boemode bakurirewu jitu bogai.

b: Icare Paore ia i ricodudo nowu Jonas uwai aogeje, tuwo boetugudo aora joki, ma kiarigodu kawo. Jonas jekare kuricigore nowu i mugui tuwai aogeje duji.
source: Icare Paore ia i ricodudo nowu Jonas uwai aogeje, tuwo boetugudo aora joki, ma kiarigodu kawo. Jonas jekare kuricigore nowu i mugui tuwai aogeje duji.

b: Mare ia barogwato, Paore nowu i arogodo ukua rugadu kowuje, du kodi icare nowu i kidure.
source: Mare ia barogwato, Paore nowu i arogodo ukua rugadu kowuje, du kodi icare nowu i kidure.

b: Dukodi icare, meri joku aregodu keje, Paoi ia bakuru ururewu aregodudo meri rutu piji dukeje, icare meri urugu rakarewu jore Jonas aora keje, dukodire ure tuwiiagu; icare okwamagudure tuwiwo du bogai, tagoi oino dutabo pemegare ii iwiwo iemode dupiji.
source: Du kodi icare, meri joku aregodu keje, Paoi ia bakuru ururewu aregodudo meri rutu piji dukeje, icare meri urugu rakarewu jore Jonas aora keje, du kodire ure tuwiiagu; icare okwamagudure tuwiwo du bogai, tagoi oino dutabo pemegare ii iwiwo iemode dupiji.

b: Icare Pao akore oino Jonas ji emearudae kana akagoiwamoduie akorigoduwo awu i keje? Akore boe jokodu boekorire ii iwiwo du bogai.
source: Icare Pao akore oino Jonas ji emearudae kana akagoiwamoduie akorigoduwo awu i keje? Akore boe jokodu boekorire ii iwiwo du bogai.

b: Mare Pao akore are amorora amagadudo ai i keje, dure maragodukare ji, aetukare ji, dure ia boeco keje jere, ia boco keje bire. Kode imi, inogudmodukare Nínive bakurirewu apo, boe emagaguragai tada tukai boe pa jice wojedu tabo, barege emagaguragai tada dutabo jamedu?
source: Mare Pao akore are amorora amagadudo ai i keje, dure maragodukare ji, aetukare ji, dure ia boeco keje jere, ia boco keje bire. Kode imi, inogudmodukare Nínive bakurirewu apo, boe emagaguragai tada tukai boe pa jice wojedu tabo, barege emagaguragai tada dutabo jamedu?

b: Jorure pobe brae eimejera ji Dário cedu keje, arii ikera awubodure boture ikera awubowuto mito, boe tojiwu meri keje, Pao bataru aregodure profeta Ageu jabiji, Salatiel naregedu Sorobabel, Judá kejewu brae eimejera, ai, Josedec naregedu Salatiel, Pao burejoiage eimejera, ai jamedu oinore Pao utugare makarewu akore awu boe egore boe emode Pao Aroe Eimejera uwai pemegado pugeje dukejewu meri aregodukare raga!
source: Jorure pobe brae eimejerai Dário cedu keje, arii ikera awubodure boture ikera awubowuto mito, boetojiwu meri keje, Pao bataru aregodure profeta Ageu jabiji, Salatiel naregedu Sorobabel, Judá kejewu brae eimejera, ai, Josedec naregedu Salatiel, Pao burejoiage eimejera, ai jamedu oinore Pao utugare makarewu akore awu boe egore boe emode Pao Aroe Eimejera uwai pemegado pugeje du kejewu meri aregodukare raga!

b: Dukodi icare Pao bataru aregodure profeta Ageu jabiji, tagoi oino dutabo umode turugadu tamuguwo bai todure irá moturewu tabowu tada, Pao uwai pegadodu tonaji?
source: Du kodi icare Pao bataru aregodure profeta Ageu jabiji, tagoi oino dutabo umode turugadu tamuguwo bai todure irá moturewu tabowu tada, Pao uwai pegadodu tonaji?

b: Kode, oinore Pao utugare makarewu akore tawiapagado tarore jiboe ji! Tare boe tugudu kuricigodo, mare takare tageragu du kurido boture moto pijiboe ji; tagogwagere mare tagogwa amogodukare; tagudure mare pobo boi taidu akedukare; tagudae meture tai mare ukare tawiri urudo: maragodurewu ure tumaragodae mori tugu ia micigu pororewu tada!
source: Kode, oinore Pao utugare makarewu akore tawiapagado tarore jiboeji! Tare boe tugudu kuricigodo, mare takare tageragu du kurido boture moto pijiboeji; tagogwagere mare tagogwa amogodukare; tagudure mare pobo boi taidu akedukare; tagudae meture tai mare ukare tawiri urudo: maragodurewu ure tumaragodae mori tugu ia micigu pororewu tada!

b: Oinore Pao utugare makarewu akore tawiapagado tarorewu boe ji! Taru torikodu ao kae, iguru arego, iwai mugudo; nono iwudugugodu mode tada, itagaru kuridodu mode, oinore Pao akore.
source: Oinore Pao utugare makarewu akore tawiapagado tarorewu boeji! Taru torikodu ao kae, iguru arego, iwai mugudo; nono iwudugugodu mode tada, itagaru kuridodu mode, oinore Pao akore.

b: Jorure pobe brae eimejera Dário cedu keje, arii ikera awubodure buture ikera awu bowu to pobe, merire ikera pudogidure iwure pudogidure buture ikera awubowuto mito, dukeje, Pao bataru aregodure profeta Ageu jabiji, tagoi oino dutabo amagodo Salatiel naregedu, Judá kejewuge eimejera, Zorobabel ji, Josedec onaregedu Pao burejoiage eimejera Josué ji, boe eiamedu boe ekobo boeji, akagoi oino dutabo kakoduwu tagiba taerdure awu bai urugu boe tojiwu ji, inoba ure taegai oino pugeje? Biega jokodukare taegai? Kode, Zorobabel, atugu ato. Oinore Pao akore. Josué, Josedec onaregedu, Pao burejoiage eimejerage eimejera, atugu ato; moto kejewu boe, tadugu tado, oinore Pao akore; tamaragodudo, iragojere tagabo, oinore Pao utugare makarewu akore. Imago magai tai, tai tadawuje Egito piji dukeje, du reorere itaroe mugure tagoiadoda. Tabagudu kaba; oinore Pao utugare makarewu akore. Boe raimodukare dukeje imode baru, moto, amagadudo; imode pobo maerewu, moto jamedu boe amagadudo; imode boe epadui pumekejeboe eiamedu boe etamagadudo; boe eiamedu boe enoroe aregodumode; imode awu iwai korobadudo irugu tabo, oinore Pao utugare makarewu akore. Ino nure meri kigadurewu, meri ekurewu, oinore Pao utugare makarewu akore. Awu maiwu bai urugu kodumode boetojiwu urugu kori, oinore Pao utugare makarewu akore; imode awu bai jiwo aidugirido. Oinore Pao utugare makarewu akore.
source: Jorure pobe brae eimejera Dário cedu keje, arii ikera awubodure buture ikera awubowuto pobe, merire ikera pudogidure iwure pudogidure buture ikera awubowuto mito, dukeje, Pao bataru aregodure profeta Ageu jabiji, tagoi oino dutabo amagodo Salatiel naregedu, Judá kejewuge eimejera, Zorobabel ji, Josedec onaregedu Pao burejoiage eimejera Josué ji, boe eiamedu boe ekobo boeji, akagoi oino dutabo kakoduwu tagiba taerdure awu bai urugu boetojiwuji, inoba ure taegai oino pugeje? Biega jokodukare taegai? Kode, Zorobabel, atugu ato. Oinore Pao akore. Josué, Josedec onaregedu, Pao burejoiage eimejerage eimejera, atugu ato; moto kejewu boe, tadugu tado, oinore Pao akore; tamaragodudo, iragojere tagabo, oinore Pao utugare makarewu akore. Imago magai tai, tai tadawuje Egito piji dukeje, du reorere itaroe mugure tagoiadoda. Tabagudu kaba; oinore Pao utugare makarewu akore. Boe raimodukare dukeje imode baru, moto, amagadudo; imode pobo maerewu, moto jamedu boe amagadudo; imode boe epadui pumekejeboe eiamedu boe etamagadudo; boe eiamedu boe enoroe aregodumode; imode awu iwai korobadudo irugu tabo, oinore Pao utugare makarewu akore. Ino nure meri kigadurewu, meri ekurewu, oinore Pao utugare makarewu akore. Awu maiwu bai urugu kodumode boetojiwu urugu kori, oinore Pao utugare makarewu akore; imode awu bai jiwo aidugirido. Oinore Pao utugare makarewu akore.

b: Imearudure imearudu kurire jiwu mako ji. Emare aregodure oino, tui taredo torekaridoge etaogeje dutabo, tui taredo aoporudoge etaogeje dutabo.
source: Imearudure imearudu kurire jiwu makoji. Emare aregodure oino, tui taredo torekaridoge etaogeje dutabo, tui taredo aoporudoge etaogeje dutabo.

b: Imearudu kurire jiwu ure nono ia pobogo ukigareure, ure nono ia kaidagaparure. Emare rakojere oino motori kuje ji taiwo tabo bai poro ji mato, toebatodu tabo meriri padui pugajejedu piji.
source: Imearudu kurire jiwu ure nono ia pobogo ukigareure, ure nono ia kaidagaparure. Emare rakojere oino motori kujei taiwo tabo baiporoji mato, toebatodu tabo meriri padui pugajejedu piji.

b: Imearudu kurire jiwu makore ii, akore oino aragojedo imedago, inagu metugu gigiri motureudo, marigu mato! Icare biaku akedure, bubutu ure marigudu. Okureboe boture pago moto piji, boe eragodure kejeboe aregodure; pamearudure pago moto keje metugu gigiri akoji. Arii tudu boture, parera okure tumaedo boe joki. Aragojedo, imedago, motureudo, mato! Inagu metugu, iordudo ai, tori poro tada, motori poro tada, imearududo amago ji. Paga karega, awadaru beture, ae moture kodi.
source: Imearudu kurire jiwu makore ii, akore oino aragojedo imedago, inagu metugu gigiri motureudo, marigu mato! Icare biaku akedure, bubutu ure marigudu. Okureboe boture pago moto piji, boe eragodure kejeboe aregodure; pamearudure pago moto keje metugu gigiri akoji. Arii tudu boture, parera okure tumaedo boe joki. Aragojedo, imedago, motureudo, mato! Inagu metugu, iordudo ai, tori poro tada, motori poro tada, imearududo amago ji. Paga karega, awadaru beture, ae moture kodi.

b: Imearudu kurire jiwu, ino nure ema, imire o nure imi jamedu.
source: Imearudu kurire jiwu, ino nure ema, imire o nure imi jamedu.

b: Oinore aredu okogereudo akore boecoji iemarure ipa keje itaroe mearudure jiboe bogai. Iemarure bogai, mare iordukare ji.
source: Oinore aredu okogereudo akore boecoji iemarure ipa keje itaroe mearudure jiboe bogai. Iemarure bogai, mare iordukare ji.

b: Imode iragojedo imerumode bakurirewu kao, bakurirewu uwororo boe kao, iemaru tabo itaroe mearudu kurire jiwu bogai. Iemarure bogai, mare iordukare ji.
source: Imode iragojedo imerumode bakurirewu kao, bakurirewu uwororo boe kao, iemaru tabo itaroe mearudu kurire jiwu bogai. Iemarure bogai, mare iordukare ji.

b: Oebatodure bakurirewu jiwuge emerure, eerdure ii taerdure itaroe mearudu kurire jiwuji?
source: Oebatodure bakurirewu jiwuge emerure, eerdure ii taerdure itaroe mearudu kurire jiwuji?

b: Ikodui ekori dutabo, iordure itaroe mearudu kurire jiwuji.
source: Ikodui ekori dutabo, iordure itaroe mearudu kurire jiwuji.

b: Itugu awaboto akanato ia kruca reore. Paga karega, boe ewi reorere boe emearudu kuriae rema. Boe etagemo akedumodukare nono boe ewi akedu bokwa reore.
source: Itugu awaboto akanato ia kruca reore. Paga karega, boe ewi reorere boe emearudu kuriae rema. Boe etagemo akedumodukare nono boe ewi akedu bokwa reore.

b: Akemore nono jeriri reore, joru aroerewu.
source: Akemore nono jeriri reore, joru aroerewu.

b: Pobore kurirewu umodukare boe emearudu kuriae bito, okwamodukare pobo boeto. Iaboe umode tuwai tadawu toroe jamedu boe maku, tuwo boe emearudu kuriae aru ma, urumode tugeragu tu boe ekiaraeji.
source: Pobore kurirewu umodukare boe emearudu kuriae bito, okwamodukare pobo boeto. Iaboe umode tuwai tadawu toroe jamedu boe maku, tuwo boe emearudu kuriae aru ma, urumode tugeragu tu boe ekiaraeji.
